title: Revealing Political Bias in LLMs through Structured Multi-Agent Debate

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating structured multi-agent debates on controversial topics (e.g., abortion, gun violence, climate change) with agents assigned Democrat, Republican, or Neutral personas, and using an LLM-as-a-judge to score their attitudes on a Likert scale across debate rounds.

Introducing male and female demographic attributes into agent personas to measure how inherent gender cues, as well as awareness of other agents' genders, influence the agents' political stances and ideological rigidity during debates.
